# agentic-ai-homelab

> The operator's homelab: the Mac mini's self-hosted services (observability, GlitchTip, Langfuse, LiteLLM, Umami, the Hub), the DGX and X3 model hosts, the workstation's agent configuration and skills, and the decisions behind them. The agent fleets themselves live in chipi/flotilla.

Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md (repo-wide) and the scoped AGENTS.md files it lists; the operator's global rules are workstation/config/AGENTS.md. The operations handbook, docs/recipes/agent-access.md, is how to read and change every running service with access that already exists: start there for anything about a live service. Docs are an MkDocs site under docs/ (ADRs, RFCs, recipes, history, wip); each infra stack documents itself in its own README.md.

This file is generated by scripts/llms_txt.py from llms.config.json; `make llms-txt` rewrites it and CI fails when it is stale.

## Agent rules

- [Repo-wide conventions](AGENTS.md#repo-wide-conventions): `.env` belongs in `.gitignore`, never in git.
- [Scoped AGENTS.md in this repo](AGENTS.md#scoped-agentsmd-in-this-repo): Folder-specific rules live next to the code they govern.
- [What overrides this file](AGENTS.md#what-overrides-this-file): Direct chat instruction > persistent memory > scoped AGENTS.md (e.g. `infra/dgx/AGENTS.md`) > this file > any …
- [lean-ctx](AGENTS.md#lean-ctx): Prefer lean-ctx MCP tools over native equivalents for token savings: `ctx_read` > Read/cat, `ctx_search` > Grep/rg …
- [The operator's global rules](workstation/config/AGENTS.md): truthfulness protocol, approvals, pushing, safety; every agent on every repo follows them
- [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md): docs workflow: the strict MkDocs build, doc hygiene, NEXT_STEPS, history arcs
- [infra/AGENTS.md](infra/AGENTS.md): infra stacks: run composes in place, symlink operator scripts
- [infra/dgx/AGENTS.md](infra/dgx/AGENTS.md): DGX host work and GPU mode coordination
- [infra/vllm/AGENTS.md](infra/vllm/AGENTS.md): local vLLM stacks: ports, key, GPU sizing
- [infra/x3/AGENTS.md](infra/x3/AGENTS.md): the X3 workstation as a deployment surface
- [provider-bakeoff/AGENTS.md](provider-bakeoff/AGENTS.md): the provider bake-off sub-project

## By service

- [LiteLLM gateway (mini :4001)](infra/litellm/README.md): GlitchTip project `litellm` (the VPS gateway is `litellm-prod`); log container `litellm`; aliases, virtual keys and budgets. Access: [handbook §9](docs/recipes/agent-access.md#9-litellm-mini-4001--httpslitellmtail6d0ed4tsnet--vps-4001)
- [GlitchTip (mini :8090)](infra/glitchtip/README.md): error tracking for every project; containers `glitchtip-*`; projects and what reports into each in [projects.json](infra/glitchtip/projects.json); access: [handbook §7](docs/recipes/agent-access.md#7-glitchtip-8090--httpsglitchtiptail6d0ed4tsnet--org-homelab)
- [VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, VictoriaTraces, Grafana](infra/observability/backend/README.md): containers `victoriametrics`, `victorialogs`, `victoriatraces`, `grafana`; logs carry `instance`, `container`, `cluster`, `env`
- [Grafana alerts](infra/observability/backend/grafana/provisioning/alerting/README.md): every provisioned alert rule, contact point and policy: what a Grafana signal in triage means
- [Collectors: Alloy, cAdvisor, DCGM, Ollama metrics](infra/observability/README.md): containers `alloy`, `alloy-homelab`, `cadvisor`, `dcgm-exporter`, `ollama-metrics`; what each host ships
- [Langfuse (mini :4000)](infra/langfuse/README.md): LLM and agent traces; containers `langfuse-*`
- [Umami (mini :3001)](infra/umami/README.md): web analytics for the sites; containers `umami`, `umami-db`
- [The Hub (homelab-home)](infra/homelab-home/README.md): the tailnet start page and its status job; container `homelab-home`
- [DGX services](infra/dgx/README.md): vLLM, moss transcription (GlitchTip `moss-dgx-transcription`), pyannote diarization (GlitchTip `pyannote-dgx-diarization`); access: [handbook §13](docs/recipes/agent-access.md#13-dgx-services)
- [Local vLLM stacks](infra/vllm/README.md): containers `vllm-*`; GPU mode coordination is in [infra/dgx/AGENTS.md](infra/dgx/AGENTS.md)
- [X3 workstation services](infra/x3/README.md): the local assistant and its evaluation stacks; access: [handbook §13b](docs/recipes/agent-access.md#13b-x3-services-omarchy-100925465)
- [GlitchTip projects of other repos](infra/glitchtip/projects.json): Close Listening (`podcast-*`, `player*`, `gi-kg-viewer`, `delivery`), Orrery (`orrery*`), websites, eval-harness (`evals-*`) and flotilla: each entry says what reports into it; their docs live in those repos
- [hetzner-status](infra/hetzner-status/README.md): Hetzner bulletins correlated with our infra: an outside cause for an alert
- [provider-status](infra/provider-status/README.md): outages and maintenance of the providers we depend on: an outside cause for an alert
- [cloudflare-edge](infra/cloudflare-edge/README.md): Cloudflare edge metrics and events for the sites
- [ci-ops-poller](infra/ci-ops-poller/README.md): CI and DORA events into VictoriaLogs

- [docker-maintenance — weekly disk reclaim on the mini](infra/docker-maintenance/README.md): The durable fix for the disk-low class (mini `/` hit `<10%` free, 2026-08-25).
- [`infra/engine/` — the Docker engine layer (layer 0)](infra/engine/README.md): The pieces that make `docker` work at all on the Mac mini, as code.
- [FastContext — Mac (Ollama) serving config](infra/fastcontext/README.md): Microsoft FastContext-1.0-4B-RL behind a local Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with the template patch required to …

- [Langfuse dashboards and saved views (as code)](infra/langfuse/views/README.md): Langfuse dashboards and saved views, created as code by build.py
- [mini-metrics — Mac mini host metrics collector to VictoriaMetrics](infra/mini-metrics/README.md): A launchd loop on the mini that feeds VictoriaMetrics the signals macOS can't get from a containerized exporter.
- [n8n: the installation's plumbing tool](infra/n8n/README.md): The layer between the company's tools and flotilla (flotilla RFC-0014 §4.0, §4.7): it calls flotilla through flotilla's …
- [node-exporter — host metrics for the mini](infra/node-exporter/README.md): Prometheus `node_exporter` on `:9100`, scraped by `alloy-homelab` (`config.alloy`, via `host.docker.internal`) and …
- [CI Ops — Grafana folder](infra/observability/backend/grafana/dashboards/CI%20Ops/README.md): CI/CD and ops-runner health from GitHub Actions.
- [Homelab — Grafana folder](infra/observability/backend/grafana/dashboards/Homelab/README.md): Core infrastructure dashboards for the Mac mini observability platform (VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs) and the DGX LLM …

- [homelab (Mac mini) self-monitoring](infra/observability/hosts/homelab/README.md): The Mac mini runs the observability backend, so it should watch itself — most importantly disk (the SSD holds all …
- [MacBook research collector](infra/observability/hosts/macbook/README.md): What a local-model run on the MacBook (Apple M4 Pro, 48 GB) needs recorded next to its results, sent to the mini over …

- [rules-drift — is Grafana running the rules the repo says?](infra/observability/rules-drift/README.md): Grafana loads `backend/grafana/provisioning/alerting/rules.yaml` only on an alerting-provisioning reload.
- [tailscale — keep the mini's own node on the tailnet without a login](infra/tailscale/README.md): The mini runs the macsys Tailscale (notarised app bundle).
- [vLLM compose template — hardened coder-next](infra/vllm/template/README.md): Hardened compose for serving a coding-class LLM on NVIDIA GB10-class hardware via vLLM, behind an `--api-key` gate.
- [provider-bakeoff](provider-bakeoff/README.md): Compare 10 LLM providers from 4 countries on the same tasks, with real cost numbers, in one command.
- [workstation/ — global agent-config, restorable](workstation/README.md): This directory is the source of truth for the operator's machine-global agent configuration.
- [~/.claude/hooks — Claude Code hooks (global, all projects)](workstation/claude/hooks/README.md): These scripts are wired into Claude Code via `~/.claude/settings.json` and run for every session in every project.
- [LeanCTX — workstation configuration and project-root isolation](workstation/config/lean-ctx/README.md): `config.toml` here is the operator's global LeanCTX config (symlinked to `~/.config/lean-ctx/config.toml` by …
- [recovery — the tiny encrypted recovery bundle](workstation/recovery/README.md): The workstation is rebuilt from this repository, the project repositories, and fresh logins.
- [storage — the Linux workstation storage layout](workstation/storage/README.md): the Btrfs subvolume layout of the Linux workstation (/work, docker, containerd outside the OS rollback); why: ADR-0011
- [streams — parallel work with Worktrunk (Linux workstation)](workstation/streams/README.md): How the Linux workstation runs parallel implementation streams next to a project's primary work.
- [tmux — workspace persistence (Linux workstation)](workstation/tmux/README.md): tmux sessions that survive a crash or reboot of the Linux workstation; why: ADR-0012
- [workbench — persistent tmux session for phone/SSH access](workstation/workbench/README.md): A always-on tmux session named `main`, one window per project, so a phone SSH client can attach and drive an agent …

## Decisions (ADRs)

- [ADR-0001 — Repo scope: four pillars, personal framing](docs/adr/ADR-0001-repo-scope.md): Accepted. Need: a single place to codify how the operator works with agentic AI — patterns extracted from across his projects …
- [ADR-0002 — Root + per-folder AGENTS.md split](docs/adr/ADR-0002-agents-md-per-folder-split.md): Accepted. The repo's agent rules lived in a single root `AGENTS.md` (~92 lines) plus two scoped files (`infra/dgx/` …
- [ADR-0003 — Custom subagent roster: model tiering + advisor/executor escalation](docs/adr/ADR-0003-subagent-roster.md): Accepted. The operator had zero custom Claude Code subagents — role-based delegation existed only in opencode (the …
- [ADR-0004 — Hardening: inline-by-default; dynamic workflow only for blind-spots](docs/adr/ADR-0004-hardening-workflow.md): Accepted. Goal: a repeatable "harden before I close a segment" pass — audit the session delta for issues, gaps, and drift across …
- [ADR-0005 — Self-hosted observability platform: metrics/logs, LLM tracing, error tracking](docs/adr/ADR-0005-langfuse-glitchtip-self-host.md): Accepted
- [ADR-0006 — Mac mini as the observability host: fresh-start migration + bootstrap/sops provisioning](docs/adr/ADR-0006-mac-mini-observability-provisioning.md): Accepted. The self-hosted platform (VictoriaMetrics/Logs/Traces + Grafana + GlitchTip + Langfuse) runs on the DGX as a stopgap.
- [ADR-0007 — Consolidate analytics on self-hosted Umami (over PostHog)](docs/adr/ADR-0007-umami-self-host-analytics.md): Accepted. Analytics were split across two products and two tools: orrery → Umami (hosted), podcast → PostHog.
- [ADR-0009 — An on-demand dev Docker engine on the mini, separate from production](docs/adr/ADR-0009-on-demand-dev-docker-engine.md): Accepted. The Mac mini runs production in one colima VM (`_dockerhost`, qemu, 20 GiB): observability, delivery, LiteLLM …
- [ADR-0010 — One telemetry naming contract, set once at the source](docs/adr/ADR-0010-telemetry-naming-contract.md): Accepted. Logs, traces and metrics name the same service with different keys and values, so no single filter follows a service …
- [ADR-0011 — Workstation storage: /work and Docker leave the root rollback domain](docs/adr/ADR-0011-workstation-storage-subvolumes.md): Accepted. The Linux development workstation (the X3, Omarchy on Arch) is one LUKS2 NVMe holding one Btrfs filesystem.
- [ADR-0012 — tmux workspace persistence: durable topology, ephemeral processes](docs/adr/ADR-0012-tmux-workspace-persistence.md): Accepted. The Linux development workstation is operated as one tmux session per project, with named windows (agent, server …
- [ADR-0013 — A staging Docker engine on the X3 for robotics-lab, behind its own socket and a sudo-only deploy](docs/adr/ADR-0013-x3-staging-docker-engine.md): Accepted. robotics-lab's deployed stack (the Observatory and Mission Control) runs on the X3, on the one Docker engine everything …
